patterns.note: Content is consistently centered within a dark, full-width background, using generous vertical spacing between major sections to create a sense of airiness despite the dense information.
A high-contrast dark theme with white text is consistently used, accented by bright yellow for primary calls to action and highlights, and a vibrant purple for secondary buttons.
Headings are large, bold sans-serif, providing strong hierarchy against lighter, smaller body text. Labels and navigation items often use uppercase for emphasis.
The site features multiple, distinct sections dedicated to showcasing sponsor logos, categorized by size (Huge, Bio, Small), which is an unusual and prominent content block.

The primary navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls. A 'Jump to Features' button appears in the bottom right corner after an initial scroll depth, providing quick navigation.

technique_notes: The site employs a dark mode aesthetic with a deep charcoal background and light text, ensuring high readability. Accent colors are used sparingly but effectively to draw attention to interactive elements and key information.

Major content sections are presented with ample vertical padding, creating clear visual breaks. Within sections, content is often arranged in responsive grids (e.g., for features and sponsor logos) that adapt to different screen sizes.

Scroll-triggered motion is minimal but functional: the main navigation bar is fixed to the top of the viewport, and a 'scroll-to' button animates into view from the bottom right after the user scrolls past the hero section, likely using CSS keyframes for its appearance.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif hero heading (~4x body) with smaller, lighter body text and uppercase labels for navigation and section titles.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding (e.g., 4-8px) on buttons, cards, and interactive elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy vertical spacing between major sections, with balanced density within content grids like features and sponsor logos.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is the extensive and prominently displayed list of sponsor logos, categorized by size, which serves as a powerful social proof element. The high-contrast dark theme with bright yellow accents is also very well-executed and visually striking.
